articles.title: XRP Ledger's new proposal blocks the flash loan attacks costing DeFi hundreds of millions
articles.snippet: A draft XRPL amendment notes that flash loan attacks are "structurally impossible" on the network because of how its transactions are built, an architectural quirk that has spared the chain from the exploit class that has cost Ethereum DeFi billions.

articles.title: Wall Street’s trillion-dollar dilemma: Why AI-powered hackers are keeping big banks off the blockchain
articles.snippet: CertiK CEO and co-founder Ronghui Gu says April was the worst month for DeFi in four years with exploits on 27 out of 30 days.

articles.title: U.S. regulator says 24/7 trading is great for crypto, may not be fit for other sectors
articles.snippet: As the CFTC issued landmark approvals for crypto perpetual futures contracts, it explained in a related advisory that round-the-clock activity isn't right for all.

articles.title: What American crypto asset perpetuals mean for the future of crypto
articles.snippet: For years, one of the most significant crypto asset markets has existed entirely outside the United States. Today, that changes, explains CFTC Chairman Selig.

articles.title: Cosmos-based Gravity Bridge halts bridge after reported $5.4M exploit
articles.snippet: Gravity Bridge was drained of roughly $5.4 million in a suspected signing key compromise, prompting validators to halt the bridge while an investigation is underway.
